title: 2026 EFF Award Winners: Access Now, 7amleh – The Arab Center for the Advancement of Social Media, DeFlock, and New Media Rights

agency_candidates.display_name: San Diego CA PD is not sharing data with any partner networks. Policy & Trust

summary: EFF announced its 2026 EFF Award winners, including DeFlock, an open-source volunteer project founded in 2024 by Will Freeman that maps ALPR and other surveillance devices to help communities push back against license-plate reader surveillance. The other honorees (Access Now, 7amleh, New Media Rights) work on broader digital rights issues.

key_quotes.quote: DeFlock is an open-source, volunteer-powered project that maps surveillance devices across the world, helping communities hold their governments and surveillance vendors accountable and understand where and how they're being watched.
DeFlock shines a light on the widespread use of automated license plate reader (ALPR) technology and the threats it poses to personal privacy and civil liberties.
